entries.name: add-dir
entries.description: Add a working directory for file access. Type a partial path to see matching directory suggestions; press Tab to accept one.

entries.name: advisor
entries.description: Enable or disable the advisor tool, which consults a second model for guidance at key moments during a task. Accepts fable, opus, sonnet, or a full model ID. fable requires Fable access.

entries.name: agents
entries.description: Print a reminder to ask Claude to create or manage subagents, or to edit .claude/agents/ or ~/.claude/agents/ directly. On v2.1.197 and earlier, opens an interactive interface for creating and managing subagent configurations

entries.name: artifact-capabilities
entries.description: Load the reference for the runtime capabilities a published artifact can use, such as calling your connectors or offering a file download, including which ones your account has. Requires artifacts

entries.name: artifact-diagramming
entries.description: Load diagramming guidance for Claude to follow in artifacts: when a diagram helps, what to draw, and how to write inline SVG that stays legible in light and dark themes. Requires Claude Code v2.1.221 or later

entries.name: artifacts
entries.description: List the artifacts you own or that are shared with you, then attach one to the session, open it in your browser, or copy its link. Available where artifacts are

entries.name: auto-mode-setup
entries.description: Draft autoMode.environment entries from your project and recent sessions, then review the draft and save it to your user settings. On a Pro, Max, Ultra, or Team plan, requires Claude Code v2.1.228 or later, or v2.1.233 or later on native Windows.

entries.name: autocompact
entries.description: Set the auto-compact window: how full the context window gets before Claude Code compacts automatically. Pass a size such as 500k, or auto to return to the window tuned for your model.

entries.name: autofix-pr
entries.description: Spawn a cloud session that watches the current branch's PR and pushes fixes when CI fails or reviewers leave comments. Detects the open PR from your checked-out branch with gh pr view; to watch a different PR, check out its branch first.

entries.name: background
entries.description: Detach the current session to run as a background agent and free this terminal. Pass a prompt to send one more instruction before detaching.

entries.name: batch
entries.description: Orchestrate large-scale changes across a codebase in parallel. Researches the codebase, decomposes the work into 5 to 30 independent units, and presents a plan.

entries.name: branch
entries.description: Create a branch of the current conversation at this point, so you can try a different direction without losing the conversation as it stands. Switches you into the branch and preserves the original, which you can return to with /resume.

entries.name: btw
entries.description: Ask a side question about the current session without adding to the conversation. If you run /btw without a question, Claude Code shows your most recent side question so you can browse earlier answers; if you haven't asked one yet, Claude Code prints a usage line

entries.name: bug
entries.description: Report a bug or share your conversation. You choose how much session history to include and confirm on a consent screen before anything is sent.

entries.name: cd
entries.description: Move this session to a new working directory, keeping the conversation. Type a partial path to see matching directory suggestions; press Tab to accept one.

entries.name: chrome
entries.description: Configure Claude in Chrome settings

entries.name: claude-api
entries.description: Load Claude API and Managed Agents reference material for your project's language. Also activates automatically when your code imports anthropic or @anthropic-ai/sdk.

entries.name: claude-approvals
entries.description: Edit, explain, or tune a Claude Approvals policy file or classifier. Requires Claude Code v2.1.331 or later and feature-flag fetching

entries.name: claude-in-chrome
entries.description: Have Claude carry out a task in your browser, such as testing a page, filling a form, or reading console logs, through Claude in Chrome. Available when Chrome integration is enabled for the session, for example with claude --chrome, or when Claude Code can offer to install the extension

entries.name: clear
entries.description: Start a new conversation with empty context. Pass a name to label the previous conversation in the /resume picker.

entries.name: code-review
entries.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number, branch, or path you pass, for correctness bugs. Depending on your model and effort level, the review also covers cleanup opportunities.

entries.name: color
entries.description: Set the prompt bar color for the current session. Available colors: red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange, pink, cyan.

entries.name: compact
entries.description: Free up context by summarizing the conversation so far. Optionally pass focus instructions for the summary.

entries.name: config
entries.description: Open the Settings interface to adjust preferences. Pass key=value pairs to set a setting directly, for example /config verbose=true, /config theme=dark, or /config model=sonnet.

entries.name: context
entries.description: Visualize current context usage as a colored grid. Shows optimization suggestions for context-heavy tools, memory bloat, and capacity warnings.

entries.name: copy
entries.description: Copy the last assistant response to clipboard. Pass a number N to copy the Nth-latest response: /copy 2 copies the second-to-last.

entries.name: cost
entries.description: Alias for /usage

entries.name: dataviz
entries.description: Design guidance for charts, graphs, and dashboards. Claude picks the chart form for the data, assigns color by role, validates the palette for colorblind safety and contrast with a bundled script, and applies mark, interaction, and accessibility rules.

entries.name: debug
entries.description: Enable debug logging for the current session and troubleshoot issues by reading the session debug log. Debug logging is off by default unless you started with claude --debug, so running /debug mid-session starts capturing logs from that point forward.

entries.name: deep-research
entries.description: Fan out web searches on a question, fetch and cross-check sources, and synthesize a cited report

entries.name: design
entries.description: Draft UI mockups, screen flows, landing pages, or posters as artboards on one canvas, published as a Claude Design artifact, for example /design a settings screen for a mobile banking app. You edit the artboards in a desktop browser, and your edits save automatically.

entries.name: design consent
entries.description: Grant Claude access to Claude Design, or withdraw it. When a reply from Claude asks you to run /design consent, type it at the Claude Code prompt yourself

entries.name: design revoke
entries.description: Grant Claude access to Claude Design, or withdraw it. When a reply from Claude asks you to run /design consent, type it at the Claude Code prompt yourself

entries.name: design-login
entries.description: Authorize design-system access for /design-sync with your claude.ai account. Sign in with /design-login whenever /design-sync or /design consent tells you to.

entries.name: design-sync
entries.description: Convert your repo's React design system and upload it to Claude Design, so designs it produces use your real components. Optionally name the design system, for example /design-sync Acme DS.

entries.name: desktop
entries.description: Continue the current session in the Claude Code Desktop app. Requires macOS or x64 Windows and a Claude subscription.

entries.name: diff
entries.description: Review the changes in your working tree, including the edits Claude has made so far. See Review changes with /diff

entries.name: doctor
entries.description: Run a setup checkup that diagnoses installation, settings, extension, and CLAUDE.md problems and proposes fixes that Claude applies after you confirm. For what the checkup covers, or to audit your instructions with prompt-audit instead, see Check your setup with /doctor.

entries.name: effort
entries.description: Set the effort level: low to xhigh, max, or auto; status prints it. ultracode or ultracode on turns ultracode on for the session, and ultracode off turns it off; the ultracode key persists. max is session-only. The on and off arguments require Claude Code v2.1.284 or later.

entries.name: exit
entries.description: Exit the CLI. In an attached background session, this detaches and the session keeps running.

entries.name: export
entries.description: Export the current conversation as plain text. With a filename, writes directly to that file, and on v2.1.327 or later refuses one that already exists.

entries.name: fast
entries.description: Toggle fast mode on or off. Run it while Claude is responding and Claude Code toggles fast mode without waiting for the turn to end, though the running turn finishes at its original speed.

entries.name: feedback
entries.description: Send product feedback about Claude Code. Opens the same dialog as /bug, with the same consent step, sending rules, and mid-turn behavior.

entries.name: fewer-permission-prompts
entries.description: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts

entries.name: focus
entries.description: Toggle the focus view, which shows only your last prompt, a one-line tool-call summary with edit diffstats, and the final response. The tool-call summary also counts the subagents launched in the turn and collapses completed background-task notifications into a single count.

entries.name: fork
entries.description: Copy the current conversation into a new background session and keep working here. Pass a prompt and the copy starts working on it immediately; without one it waits in agent view for its first prompt.

entries.name: goal
entries.description: Set a goal: Claude keeps working across turns until the condition is met or the goal clears for another reason. With no argument, shows the current or most recently achieved goal. clear, stop, off, reset, none, or cancel removes an active goal early

entries.name: heapdump
entries.description: Write a JavaScript heap snapshot and a memory breakdown to ~/Desktop, or your home directory on Linux without a Desktop folder, for diagnosing high memory usage. Attach only the -diagnostics.json file when reporting a memory issue; the .heapsnapshot contains your full conversation and credentials, so don't share it.

entries.name: help
entries.description: Show help and available commands

entries.name: hooks
entries.description: View hook configurations

entries.name: ide
entries.description: Manage IDE integrations and show status

entries.name: import
entries.description: Bring configuration from OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini CLI, or Cursor on your machine into Claude Code, including instruction files, MCP servers, commands, subagents, and skills. In non-interactive mode with -p, /import lists what it found and gives you the command that confirms the import.

entries.name: init
entries.description: Initialize project with a CLAUDE.md guide. Set CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1 for an interactive flow that also walks through skills, hooks, and personal memory files.

entries.name: insights
entries.description: Generate an HTML report analyzing your recent sessions on this machine: which projects you work in, how you use Claude Code, where things go wrong, and features to try. Not available in cloud sessions.

entries.name: install-github-app
entries.description: Install the Claude GitHub App for a repository, with an optional step to set up GitHub Actions workflows and secrets. Walks you through selecting a repo and configuring the integration.

entries.name: install-slack-app
entries.description: Install the Claude Slack app. Opens a browser to complete the OAuth flow

entries.name: keybindings
entries.description: Open your keyboard shortcuts file

entries.name: list-agents
entries.description: List the subagents, agent team teammates, and other Claude Code sessions Claude can message, with the name to use for each. See cross-session messaging.

entries.name: login
entries.description: Sign in to your Anthropic account

entries.name: logout
entries.description: Sign out from your Anthropic account

entries.name: loop
entries.description: Run a prompt repeatedly while the session stays open. Omit the interval and Claude self-paces between iterations.

entries.name: mcp
entries.description: Manage MCP server connections and OAuth authentication. Run with no argument to open the interactive list, or pass reconnect, enable, or disable with a server name or all to change connection state without opening it. reconnect all retries every server that failed or needs authentication.

entries.name: memory
entries.description: Edit CLAUDE.md files, enable or disable auto memory, and view auto memory entries

entries.name: mobile
entries.description: Show QR code to download the Claude mobile app. Aliases: /ios, /android

entries.name: model
entries.description: Switch the AI model and save it as your default for new sessions. For models that support it, use left/right arrows to adjust effort level.

entries.name: motion
entries.description: Make a new animation from your brief as a Claude Motion artifact, for example /motion an explainer of how our deploy pipeline works. Available in local sessions in the Desktop app and in Anthropic-hosted cloud sessions, not in the terminal or IDE extensions.

entries.name: output-style
entries.description: List output styles or switch to one, for example /output-style concise. See Change your output style.

entries.name: passes
entries.description: Share a free week of Claude Code with friends. Only visible if your account is eligible

entries.name: permissions
entries.description: Manage allow, ask, and deny rules for tool permissions. Opens an interactive dialog where you can view rules by scope, add or remove rules, manage working directories, and review recent auto mode denials.

entries.name: plan
entries.description: Enter plan mode directly from the prompt. Pass an optional description to enter plan mode and immediately start with that task, for example /plan fix the auth bug

entries.name: plugin
entries.description: Manage Claude Code plugins. Run with no argument to open the plugin menu, or pass a subcommand such as list, install, enable, or disable to act directly.

entries.name: plugin-authoring
entries.description: Load the reference Claude works from to write a mod. Claude can load it on its own when you ask for a mod.

entries.name: powerup
entries.description: Discover Claude Code features through quick interactive lessons with animated demos

entries.name: pr-comments
entries.description: Removed in v2.1.91. Ask Claude directly to view pull request comments instead.

entries.name: privacy-settings
entries.description: View and update your privacy settings or get a link to them on claude.ai. Only available for Pro, Max, and Ultra plan subscribers

entries.name: radio
entries.description: Open Claude FM lo-fi radio in your browser. Prints the stream URL when no browser is available

entries.name: rate-limit-options
entries.description: Show ways to keep working when a claude.ai usage limit blocks a request: wait and continue automatically when the limit resets, add usage credits, or upgrade your plan. Claude Code can also open this menu on its own when you hit a limit at your own terminal.

entries.name: recap
entries.description: Generate a one-line summary of the current session on demand. See Session recap for the automatic recap that appears after you've been away

entries.name: release-notes
entries.description: View the changelog in an interactive version picker. Select a specific version to see its release notes, or choose to show all versions.

entries.name: reload-plugins
entries.description: Reload all active plugins to apply pending changes without restarting. Reports counts for each reloaded component and flags any load errors.

entries.name: reload-skills
entries.description: Re-scan skill and command directories so skills added or changed on disk during the session become available without restarting. Reports how many skills are available and how many were added or removed

entries.name: remote-control
entries.description: Make this session available for Remote Control from claude.ai. Running it while signed out prints that Remote Control requires a claude.ai subscription and tells you how to sign in.

entries.name: remote-env
entries.description: Choose the default cloud environment for cloud sessions you start from the CLI

entries.name: rename
entries.description: Rename the current session and show the name on the prompt bar. Without a name, auto-generates one from conversation history.

entries.name: restart
entries.description: Restart Claude Code and resume this session, which applies an installed update. Run it when the footer offers it after an update installs.

entries.name: resume
entries.description: Resume a conversation by ID or name, or open the session picker. Background sessions appear in the picker marked with bg.

entries.name: review
entries.description: Alias of /code-review: reviews the current diff, or a PR number, branch, or path you pass, such as /review 1234, and takes the same effort levels and flags. With no level given, the review reuses the last low through max level you typed; see Review locally with /code-review for the exact rules.

entries.name: rewind
entries.description: Rewind the conversation and/or code to a previous point, or summarize from a selected message. See checkpointing.

entries.name: run
entries.description: Launch and drive your project's app to see a change working, not only passing tests. See Run and verify your app

entries.name: run-skill-generator
entries.description: Teach /run and /verify how to build, launch, and drive your project's app from a clean environment by writing a per-project skill

entries.name: sandbox
entries.description: Toggle sandbox mode. Available on supported platforms only

entries.name: schedule
entries.description: Create, update, list, or run cloud scheduled tasks, formerly routines. Claude walks you through the setup conversationally.

entries.name: scroll-speed
entries.description: Adjust mouse wheel scroll speed interactively. Available in fullscreen rendering only and not in the JetBrains IDE terminal

entries.name: security-review
entries.description: Analyze the changes on your current branch for security vulnerabilities. Reviews the diff between your branch and origin's default branch, identifying risks like injection, auth issues, and data exposure.

entries.name: setup-bedrock
entries.description: Configure Amazon Bedrock authentication, region, and model pins through an interactive wizard. Hidden from the command menu until CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1 is set; type it in full.

entries.name: setup-vertex
entries.description: Configure Google Cloud's Agent Platform authentication, project, region, and model pins through an interactive wizard. Hidden from the command menu until CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1 is set; type it in full.

entries.name: ship
entries.description: Commit and push your work where /ship can, open a GitHub pull request for your branch if it has none, then review the change. Claude then watches the pull request in this session and pushes fixes for review feedback and failing checks.

entries.name: ship:review
entries.description: Alias for /code-review

entries.name: simplify
entries.description: Review the changed code for cleanup opportunities and apply the fixes. Four review agents run in parallel, covering reuse of existing helpers, simplification, efficiency, and whether the change is at the right level of abstraction.

entries.name: skill-doctor
entries.description: Show what each of your skills costs in context and how often it gets used, so you can find skills to turn off. Requires Claude Code v2.1.252 or later and feature-flag fetching

entries.name: skills
entries.description: List available skills. Type to filter the list by name, description, or source.

entries.name: slides
entries.description: Make a new presentation as a Claude Slides artifact filled from your brief, for example /slides a quarterly review of the platform team. Requires Claude Code v2.1.265 or later, a session where artifacts are available, and an account where the Slides template is available; otherwise the command doesn't appear.

entries.name: stats
entries.description: Alias for /usage. Opens on the Stats tab

entries.name: status
entries.description: Open the Settings interface on the Status tab, showing version, model, account, and connectivity. A Session kind row reads background job · attached or background job · unattended in a background session, depending on whether a terminal is attached, and interactive in any other session.

entries.name: statusline
entries.description: Configure Claude Code's status line. Describe what you want, or run without arguments to auto-configure from your shell prompt

entries.name: steward
entries.description: Watch your open GitHub pull request in this session and push fixes for review feedback and failing checks, without the review that /ship runs first. /steward stop ends the watch.

entries.name: stickers
entries.description: Check Claude Code sticker availability

entries.name: stop
entries.description: Stop the background session you're attached to, or the one you send it to as a peek reply; the transcript and any worktree are kept. To detach without stopping, use /exit or press ←

entries.name: subtask
entries.description: Spawn a forked subagent: a background subagent that inherits the full conversation and works on the task while you keep working. Its result returns to this conversation when it finishes.

entries.name: tasks
entries.description: View and manage background work in the current session, including subagents that have finished. Also available as /bashes

entries.name: team-onboarding
entries.description: Generate a team onboarding guide from your Claude Code usage history. Claude analyzes your sessions, commands, and MCP server usage from the past 30 days.

entries.name: teleport
entries.description: Pull a cloud session into this terminal. Opens a picker, then loads the conversation.

entries.name: terminal-setup
entries.description: Install a Shift+Enter keybinding for newlines in VS Code, Cursor, Devin Desktop, Alacritty, or Zed. In Apple Terminal, turn off the audible bell instead.

entries.name: theme
entries.description: Change the color theme. Includes an auto option that matches your terminal's light or dark background, light and dark variants, colorblind-accessible (daltonized) themes, ANSI themes that use your terminal's color palette, and any custom themes from ~/.claude/themes/ or plugins.

entries.name: tui
entries.description: Set the terminal UI renderer and relaunch into it. fullscreen enables the flicker-free alt-screen renderer. default, or classic on v2.1.327 or later, selects the classic renderer. With no argument, prints the active renderer

entries.name: ultraplan
entries.description: Removed. Use plan mode instead.

entries.name: ultrareview
entries.description: Run a deep, multi-agent code review in a cloud sandbox with ultrareview. Pass a PR reference to review that pull request, or a base branch or commit to change the comparison base.

entries.name: update-config
entries.description: Describe a settings change, such as allowing a command, setting an environment variable, or adding a hook, and Claude edits the matching settings.json file. For options such as theme and model, use /config instead

entries.name: upgrade
entries.description: Open the upgrade page in your browser to switch to a higher plan tier. When no browser can open the page, for example over SSH, the command prints the page's URL above its sign-in prompt.

entries.name: usage
entries.description: Show session cost, plan usage limits, and activity stats. On a Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, or Enterprise plan, includes a breakdown of what counts against your plan limits.

entries.name: usage-credits
entries.description: Configure usage credits, or request them from your admin, when you hit a limit. Opens your usage-credits billing settings in the browser.

entries.name: verify
entries.description: Confirm a code change does what it should by building your project's app, running it, and observing the result, rather than relying on tests or type checks. See Run and verify your app

entries.name: vim
entries.description: Removed in v2.1.92. To toggle between Vim and Normal editing modes, use /config → Editor mode

entries.name: voice
entries.description: Toggle voice dictation, or enable it in a specific mode. Requires a Claude.ai account

entries.name: web-setup
entries.description: Connect your GitHub account for cloud sessions using your local gh CLI credentials

entries.name: whiteboard
entries.description: Make a new whiteboard from your brief as a Claude Whiteboards artifact, for example /whiteboard a service map of the checkout flow. Requires Claude Code v2.1.323 or later, a session where artifacts are available, and an account where the Whiteboards template is available.

entries.name: workflow-authoring
entries.description: Load the reference for writing dynamic workflow scripts: the script API, resume behavior, quality patterns, and worked examples. Claude normally loads it on its own before writing a script; run it yourself before editing a saved script by hand.

entries.name: workflows
entries.description: Open the workflow progress view to watch, pause, resume, or save running and completed workflows

entries.name: claude
entries.description: Start interactive session

entries.name: claude "query"
entries.description: Start interactive session with initial prompt

entries.name: claude -p "query"
entries.description: Query via SDK, then exit

entries.name: cat file | claude -p "query"
entries.description: Process piped content

entries.name: claude -c
entries.description: Continue most recent conversation in current directory

entries.name: claude -c -p "query"
entries.description: Continue via SDK

entries.name: claude -r "<session>" "query"
entries.description: Resume session by ID or name

entries.name: claude update
entries.description: Update to latest version

entries.name: claude gateway
entries.description: Start the self-hosted Claude apps gateway server, for administrators deploying SSO and policy in front of Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, or Microsoft Foundry. Requires --config pointing at a gateway.yaml.

entries.name: claude install [version]
entries.description: Install or reinstall the native binary. Accepts a version like 2.1.118, or stable or latest.

entries.name: claude auth login
entries.description: Sign in to your Anthropic account. Use --email to pre-fill your email address, --sso to force SSO authentication, and --console to sign in with Anthropic Console for API usage billing instead of a Claude subscription.

entries.name: claude auth logout
entries.description: Log out from your Anthropic account

entries.name: claude auth status
entries.description: Show authentication status as JSON. Use --text for human-readable output.

entries.name: claude agents
entries.description: Open agent view to monitor and dispatch parallel background sessions. Use --cwd <path> to show only sessions started under that directory, or --json to print active sessions as a JSON array for scripting (--json --all also includes completed background sessions).

entries.name: claude attach <id|name>
entries.description: Attach to a background session in this terminal. Passing part of a running session's name in place of the ID requires Claude Code v2.1.290 or later

entries.name: claude auto-mode defaults
entries.description: Print the auto mode classifier rules built into Claude Code as JSON. Use claude auto-mode config to see those rules with your settings applied.

entries.name: claude auto-mode reset
entries.description: Restore the default auto mode configuration by removing the autoMode section from your user settings file. Prompts for confirmation before writing; pass -y/--yes to skip the prompt.

entries.name: claude daemon logs
entries.description: Follow the background-session supervisor's log file, ~/.claude/daemon.log, printing new lines as they arrive until you press Ctrl+C

entries.name: claude daemon run
entries.description: Run the background-session supervisor in the foreground of this terminal, printing its log

entries.name: claude daemon status
entries.description: Print the background-session supervisor's state, version, socket directory, and worker count for diagnostics. Exits 1 if the supervisor isn't running

entries.name: claude daemon stop --any
entries.description: Stop the background-session supervisor and the sessions it hosts. Pass --keep-workers to leave background sessions running for the next supervisor to reconnect to.

entries.name: claude doctor
entries.description: Print read-only installation and settings diagnostics from the terminal without starting a session, including install health, settings-file validation errors, and Remote Control eligibility. For the in-session setup checkup that can also apply fixes, run /doctor

entries.name: claude import [source]
entries.description: Start an interactive session that runs /import to bring configuration from other coding agents into Claude Code. Accepts the same --dry-run and --yes options as the command.

entries.name: claude logs <id|name>
entries.description: Print recent output from a background session. Passing part of a session's name in place of the ID requires Claude Code v2.1.290 or later

entries.name: claude mcp
entries.description: Configure Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers

entries.name: claude mcp login <name>
entries.description: Run a configured MCP server's OAuth flow without opening the interactive /mcp panel. Works for HTTP, SSE, and claude.ai connector servers.

entries.name: claude mcp logout <name>
entries.description: Clear stored OAuth credentials for an MCP server

entries.name: claude plugin
entries.description: Manage Claude Code plugins. Alias: claude plugins.

entries.name: claude purge [path]
entries.description: Delete all local Claude Code state for a project: transcripts, task lists, debug logs, file-edit history, prompt history lines, and the project's entry in ~/.claude.json. Omit [path] to pick from an interactive list.

entries.name: claude remote-control
entries.description: Start a Remote Control server to control Claude Code from claude.ai or the Claude app. Alias: claude rc.

entries.name: claude respawn <id>
entries.description: Restart a background session, running or stopped, with its conversation intact. Use --all to restart every running session, e.g. to pick up an updated Claude Code binary

entries.name: claude rm <id>
entries.description: Remove a background session from the list. If Claude Code refuses to delete the session because of its worktree, see Delete a session after Claude Code refuses.

entries.name: claude self-hosted-runner
entries.description: Start a runner process that registers this machine or container with a self-hosted environment and hosts Claude Code cloud sessions on your infrastructure.

entries.name: claude setup-token
entries.description: Generate a long-lived OAuth token for CI and scripts. Prints the token to the terminal without saving it.

entries.name: claude stop <id>
entries.description: Stop a background session. Also accepts claude kill

entries.name: claude ultrareview [target]
entries.description: Run ultrareview non-interactively. Prints findings to stdout and exits 0 on success or 1 on failure.

entries.name: --add-dir
entries.description: Add additional working directories for Claude to read and edit files. Grants file access; Claude Code doesn't discover most .claude/ configuration from these directories.

entries.name: --advisor
entries.description: Enable the server-side advisor tool for this session with a model alias, fable, opus, or sonnet, or a full model ID. Takes precedence over the advisorModel setting for the session. fable requires Fable access

entries.name: --agent
entries.description: Specify an agent for the current session (overrides the agent setting)

entries.name: --agents
entries.description: Define custom subagents dynamically via JSON. Accepts the fields listed for CLI-defined subagents.
entries.example: claude --agents '{"reviewer":{"description":"Reviews code","prompt":"You are a code reviewer"}}'

entries.name: --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions
entries.description: Add bypassPermissions to the Shift+Tab mode cycle without starting in it. While bypassPermissions is in the cycle of an interactive terminal session, most edits and commands Claude attempts in plan mode can run with no prompt, before you approve a plan.

entries.name: --allowedTools
entries.description: Tools that execute without prompting for permission, apart from reads from network paths. See permission rule syntax for pattern matching.

entries.name: --append-subagent-system-prompt
entries.description: Append custom text to the end of every subagent's system prompt, nested subagents included, apart from a forked subagent, which reuses the conversation's own prompt. Only applies in non-interactive mode with -p.
entries.example: claude -p --append-subagent-system-prompt "Cite file paths in every answer" "query"

entries.name: --append-subagent-system-prompt-file
entries.description: Load text from a file and append it to subagent system prompts. An alternative to --append-subagent-system-prompt for text too long to pass on the command line.

entries.name: --append-system-prompt
entries.description: Append custom text to the end of the default system prompt

entries.name: --append-system-prompt-file
entries.description: Load additional system prompt text from a file and append to the default prompt

entries.name: --autocompact
entries.description: Set the auto-compact window for this session without changing your saved settings. Accepts the same values as /autocompact; that section covers the value forms and what overrides the flag.

entries.name: --ax-screen-reader
entries.description: Render screen-reader friendly output: flat text without decorative borders or animations. Forces the classic renderer, so the tui setting has no effect; attached background sessions still render fullscreen.

entries.name: --bare
entries.description: Minimal mode: skip auto-discovery of your hooks and of skills, custom commands, subagents, installed plugins, MCP servers, auto memory, and CLAUDE.md so scripted calls start faster. Skills in a directory you pass with --add-dir still load.

entries.name: --betas
entries.description: Beta headers to include in API requests (API key users only)

entries.name: --bg
entries.description: Start the session as a background agent and return immediately. Prints the session ID and management commands.

entries.name: --channels
entries.description: (Research preview) MCP servers whose channel notifications Claude should listen for in this session. Space-separated list of plugin:<name>@<marketplace> entries.

entries.name: --chrome
entries.description: Enable Chrome browser integration for web automation and testing

entries.name: --cloud
entries.description: With a task description, create a new cloud session. With a session ID (session_... or cse_...) or a claude.ai/code URL, queue a message into that existing session instead, with -p.

entries.name: --continue
entries.description: Load the most recent conversation in the current directory, including a background session that has finished; opening finished background sessions requires Claude Code v2.1.257 or later.

entries.name: --correlation-id
entries.description: With --environment, pass an ID to the spawn-runner hook as CLAUDE_RUNNER_CORRELATION_ID. Requires Claude Code v2.1.328 or later

entries.name: --dangerously-load-development-channels
entries.description: Enable channels that are not on the approved allowlist, for local development. Accepts plugin:<name>@<marketplace> and server:<name> entries.

entries.name: --dangerously-skip-permissions
entries.description: Skip permission prompts. Equivalent to --permission-mode bypassPermissions.

entries.name: --debug
entries.description: Enable debug mode with optional category filtering, such as --debug='mcp,startup' or --debug='!mcp'. The filter binds only in the = form; a space-separated filter enables debug mode without filtering

entries.name: --debug-file
entries.description: Write debug logs to a specific file path. Implicitly enables debug mode.

entries.name: --desktop
entries.description: Open the Claude Desktop app on the current directory and exit without starting a session in the terminal. Add --continue, or --resume with a session ID, to open that session in Desktop instead.

entries.name: --disable-slash-commands
entries.description: Disable all skills and commands for this session

entries.name: --disallowedTools
entries.description: Deny rules. A bare tool name removes the matching tools from Claude's context: "Edit" removes Edit, "" removes every tool, and "mcp__" removes every MCP tool.

entries.name: --effort
entries.description: Set the effort level for the current session. Options: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or ultracode.

entries.name: --environment
entries.description: Create a new cloud session that runs on the self-hosted environment with the given ID. Environment IDs start with ccpool_.

entries.name: --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections
entries.description: Move per-user context, such as the auto memory location, out of the system prompt and into the first user message. Improves prompt-cache reuse across different users and machines running the same task.

entries.name: --exec
entries.description: Run a shell command as a PTY-backed background job instead of starting a Claude session. Use with --bg to launch from the shell

entries.name: --fallback-model
entries.description: Enable automatic fallback to the specified model(s) when the primary model is overloaded or not available, for example a retired model. Accepts a comma-separated list tried in order.

entries.name: --fork-session
entries.description: When resuming, create a new session ID instead of reusing the original (use with --resume or --continue)

entries.name: --forward-subagent-text
entries.description: Emit subagent text and thinking blocks in the output stream as assistant and user messages with parent_tool_use_id set, so you can reconstruct each subagent's transcript. Without this flag, Claude Code omits the text and thinking blocks of a subagent that runs in the foreground.

entries.name: --from-pr
entries.description: Open the session picker filtered to sessions linked to a specific pull request. Accepts a PR number, a GitHub or GitHub Enterprise PR URL, a GitLab merge request URL, or a Bitbucket pull request URL.

entries.name: --ide
entries.description: Automatically connect to IDE on startup if exactly one valid IDE is available

entries.name: --init
entries.description: Run Setup hooks with the init matcher before the session (print mode only)

entries.name: --init-only
entries.description: Run Setup and SessionStart hooks, then exit without starting a conversation

entries.name: --include-hook-events
entries.description: Include hook lifecycle events in the output stream. SessionStart and Setup hook events are always included and don't need this flag.

entries.name: --include-partial-messages
entries.description: Include partial streaming events in output. Requires --print and --output-format stream-json

entries.name: --input-format
entries.description: Specify input format for print mode (options: text, stream-json)

entries.name: --json-schema
entries.description: Get validated JSON output matching a JSON Schema after the agent completes its workflow (print mode only). See structured outputs.

entries.name: --maintenance
entries.description: Run Setup hooks with the maintenance matcher before the session (print mode only)

entries.name: --max-budget-usd
entries.description: Stop the run once estimated spend on API calls reaches this amount (print mode only). Claude Code checks the cap against its client-side cost estimate, which can differ from your bill.

entries.name: --max-turns
entries.description: Limit the number of agentic turns (print mode only). No limit by default.

entries.name: --mcp-config
entries.description: Load MCP servers from JSON files or strings (space-separated). When you pass this flag with -p, Claude Code waits for still-pending servers to connect before running the first turn, up to the MCP_TIMEOUT startup timeout, 30 seconds by default; a server with a cached tool list skips the wait and connects on first use.

entries.name: --metadata
entries.description: With --environment, label the new session for the orchestrator's --hook-label. Repeatable.

entries.name: --model
entries.description: Sets the model for the current session with a model alias such as sonnet, opus, haiku, or fable, or a model's full name. Overrides the model setting and ANTHROPIC_MODEL

entries.name: --name
entries.description: Set a display name for the session, shown in /resume and the terminal title. You can resume a named session with claude --resume <name>.

entries.name: --no-chrome
entries.description: Disable Chrome browser integration for this session

entries.name: --no-session-persistence
entries.description: Disable session persistence so sessions are not saved to disk and cannot be resumed. Print mode only.

entries.name: --output-format
entries.description: Specify output format for print mode (options: text, json, stream-json)

entries.name: --permission-mode
entries.description: Begin in a specified permission mode. Accepts default, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions, or manual as an alias for default.

entries.name: --permission-prompt-tool
entries.description: Specify an MCP tool to handle permission prompts in non-interactive mode. Pass the full name, such as mcp<server><tool>, of a tool on an MCP server that the run loads.

entries.name: --permission-prompts
entries.description: Set who answers permission prompts in print mode. With the default host, Claude Code sends them to the Agent SDK host or the --permission-prompt-tool tool.

entries.name: --plugin-dir
entries.description: Load a plugin from a directory or .zip archive, or several from a folder of plugins, for this session only. Each flag takes one path.

entries.name: --plugin-url
entries.description: Fetch a plugin .zip archive from a URL for this session only. Repeat the flag for multiple plugins, or pass space-separated URLs in a single quoted value

entries.name: --print
entries.description: Print response without interactive mode (see Agent SDK documentation for programmatic usage details). For --resume on a background session that is still running, see Resume a running background session

entries.name: --prompt-suggestions
entries.description: Emit a prompt_suggestion message with a predicted next user prompt after each turn that generates one; very short conversations can produce none. Requires --print, --output-format stream-json, and --verbose.

entries.name: --ref
entries.description: With --environment, base the new session's checkout on a named ref. Requires Claude Code v2.1.224 or later
entries.example: claude -p "Run the smoke test" --environment ccpool_abc123 --ref main

entries.name: --remote
entries.description: Deprecated alias for --cloud, including the existing-session form

entries.name: --remote-control
entries.description: Start an interactive session with Remote Control enabled so you can also control it from claude.ai or the Claude app. Optionally pass a name for the session

entries.name: --remote-control-session-name-prefix
entries.description: Prefix for auto-generated Remote Control session names when no explicit name is set. Defaults to your machine's hostname, producing names like myhost-graceful-unicorn.

entries.name: --replay-user-messages
entries.description: Re-emit user messages from stdin back on stdout for acknowledgment. Requires --input-format stream-json and --output-format stream-json

entries.name: --restricted
entries.description: Start in restricted mode. Use it when an evaluation harness drives claude on a shared machine and Claude Code must not run commands or read that machine's user and project settings.

entries.name: --resume
entries.description: Resume a specific session by ID or name, or show an interactive picker to choose a session. In place of an ID, you can pass the absolute path to a session's .jsonl transcript file.

entries.name: --safe-mode
entries.description: Start with all customizations disabled to troubleshoot a broken configuration: CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, custom commands and agents, output styles, workflows, custom themes, custom keybindings, status line and file-suggestion commands, LSP servers, and auto memory do not load.

entries.name: --session-id
entries.description: Use a specific session ID for the conversation (must be a valid UUID)

entries.name: --setting-sources
entries.description: Comma-separated list of setting sources to load (user, project, local). See agent view and agent teams for the sessions you start from this one that inherit the list

entries.name: --settings
entries.description: Path to a settings JSON file or an inline JSON string. Values you set here override the same keys in your settings.json files for this session, but most lists merge with theirs.

entries.name: --strict-mcp-config
entries.description: Skip the MCP servers configured in places such as .mcp.json, ~/.claude.json, or a plugin, and load the ones you pass with --mcp-config. See Exclusive control with managed-mcp.json for what the flag does under a managed MCP file

entries.name: --system-prompt
entries.description: Replace the entire system prompt with custom text

entries.name: --system-prompt-file
entries.description: Load system prompt from a file, replacing the default prompt

entries.name: --system-prompt-snapshot
entries.description: Pass off to rebuild the system prompt on every request instead of reusing the prompt recorded on the conversation's first request, for example while you iterate on --append-system-prompt text across --continue runs. Requires Claude Code v2.1.257 or later

entries.name: --teleport
entries.description: Resume a cloud session in your local terminal

entries.name: --teammate-mode
entries.description: Set how agent team teammates display: in-process (default), auto, tmux, or iterm2. Overrides the teammateMode setting for this session.

entries.name: --tmux
entries.description: Create a tmux session for the worktree. Requires --worktree.

entries.name: --tools
entries.description: Restrict which built-in tools Claude can use. Use "" to disable all, "default" for the default set, or tool names like "Bash,Edit,Read".

entries.name: --verbose
entries.description: Enable verbose logging, shows full turn-by-turn output. Overrides the viewMode setting for this session

entries.name: --version
entries.description: Output the version number

entries.name: --worktree
entries.description: Start Claude in an isolated git worktree at <repo>/.claude/worktrees/<name>. If you don't give a name, Claude Code generates one.

entries.name: Ctrl+C
entries.description: Interrupt, or clear input
entries.outputBehavior: Interrupts a running operation. If nothing is running, the first press clears the prompt input and a second press exits Claude Code.

entries.name: Ctrl+X Ctrl+K
entries.description: Stop all running background subagents in this session, and turn off artifact auto-replies for the rest of it. Press twice within 3 seconds to confirm.
entries.outputBehavior: Subagent control

entries.name: Ctrl+D
entries.description: Exit Claude Code session
entries.outputBehavior: The first press shows a confirmation hint and a second press within 800ms exits. When the prompt has text, Ctrl+D deletes the character after the cursor instead

entries.name: Ctrl+G or Ctrl+X Ctrl+E
entries.description: Open in default text editor
entries.outputBehavior: Edit your prompt or custom response in your default text editor. Ctrl+X Ctrl+E is the readline-native binding.

entries.name: Ctrl+L
entries.description: Redraw the screen
entries.outputBehavior: Forces a full terminal redraw, keeping input and conversation history. Use this to recover if the display becomes garbled or partially blank.

entries.name: Ctrl+O
entries.description: Toggle transcript viewer
entries.outputBehavior: Shows detailed tool usage and execution, with a timestamp and the model used on each assistant message. Also expands lines that collapse by default, such as MCP calls, shown as a single Called slack 3 times line, and messages from your other sessions, shown as a one-line Message from @<sender> preview

entries.name: Ctrl+R
entries.description: Reverse search command history
entries.outputBehavior: Search through previous commands interactively

entries.command: Ctrl+V or Cmd+V (iTerm2) or Alt+V (Windows and WSL)
entries.name: Ctrl+V or Cmd+V (iTerm2) or Alt+V (Windows and WSL)
entries.description: Paste image from clipboard
entries.outputBehavior: Inserts an [Image #N] chip at the cursor so you can reference it positionally in your prompt. On WSL, both Ctrl+V and Alt+V are bound; use Alt+V if your terminal intercepts Ctrl+V

entries.name: Ctrl+B
entries.description: Background running tasks
entries.outputBehavior: Backgrounds Bash commands and agents. Tmux users press twice

entries.name: Ctrl+T
entries.description: Toggle Claude's task checklist
entries.outputBehavior: Show or hide Claude's to-do checklist in the status area. This is not the background-task view; use /tasks to see running shells and subagents

entries.name: Ctrl+S
entries.description: Stash or restore prompt
entries.outputBehavior: With text in the input, stashes it and clears the prompt. Pressed again on an empty prompt, restores the stashed text, cursor position, pasted content, and input mode, so a stashed ! shell command comes back in shell mode

entries.name: Ctrl+Z
entries.description: Suspend Claude Code
entries.outputBehavior: Unix only. Suspends the process to your shell; run fg to resume

entries.name: Left/Right arrows
entries.description: Cycle through dialog tabs
entries.outputBehavior: Navigate between tabs in permission dialogs and menus. In a tabbed dialog, the keys switch tabs while the tab row has focus.

entries.name: Tab
entries.description: Accept an autocomplete suggestion, or add a comment to a permission answer
entries.outputBehavior: While autocomplete suggestions are showing in the prompt input, accepts the selected suggestion. On most permission prompts, with Yes or No focused, opens a comment field on that option, and pressing it again closes the field.

entries.name: Up/Down arrows or Ctrl+P/Ctrl+N
entries.description: Move cursor or navigate command history
entries.outputBehavior: When the input spans more than one visual row, whether wrapped or multiline, first moves the cursor within the prompt. Once the cursor is on the first or last visual row, pressing again navigates command history.

entries.name: Esc
entries.description: Interrupt Claude, or close a dialog
entries.outputBehavior: Stop the current response or tool call mid-turn so you can redirect. Claude keeps the work done so far.

entries.name: Esc + Esc
entries.description: Clear input draft, or rewind
entries.outputBehavior: Outside vim mode, when the prompt input contains text, double Esc clears it and saves the draft to history so Up recalls it. When the input is empty, double Esc opens the rewind menu to restore or summarize code and conversation from a previous point.

entries.name: Ctrl+Enter or Ctrl+X Ctrl+S
entries.description: Send queued messages now
entries.outputBehavior: Sends your queued messages, and your draft with them, right away. When Claude Code sends what you queued covers what happens to the turn Claude is working on.

entries.command: Shift+Tab, or Alt+M on Windows when the Node or Bun runtime doesn't enable VT input mode
entries.name: Shift+Tab, or Alt+M on Windows when the Node or Bun runtime doesn't enable VT input mode
entries.description: Cycle permission modes
entries.outputBehavior: Cycle through default (labeled Manual in the mode indicator), acceptEdits, and plan, then bypassPermissions and auto where available. See permission modes.

entries.name: Option+P (macOS) or Alt+P (Windows/Linux)
entries.description: Switch model
entries.outputBehavior: Switch models without clearing your prompt

entries.name: Option+T (macOS) or Alt+T (Windows/Linux)
entries.description: Toggle extended thinking
entries.outputBehavior: Enable or disable extended thinking mode. Has no effect on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, or the Fable models, which always use extended thinking.

entries.name: Option+O (macOS) or Alt+O (Windows/Linux)
entries.description: Toggle fast mode
entries.outputBehavior: Enable or disable fast mode

entries.name: Ctrl+A
entries.description: Move cursor to start of current line
entries.outputBehavior: In multiline input, moves to the start of the current logical line

entries.name: Ctrl+E
entries.description: Move cursor to end of current line
entries.outputBehavior: In multiline input, moves to the end of the current logical line

entries.name: Ctrl+K
entries.description: Delete to end of line
entries.outputBehavior: Stores deleted text for pasting

entries.name: Ctrl+U
entries.description: Delete from cursor to line start
entries.outputBehavior: Stores deleted text for pasting. Repeat to clear across lines in multiline input.

entries.name: Ctrl+W
entries.description: Delete back to previous whitespace
entries.outputBehavior: Stores deleted text for pasting. One press removes a whole path or --flag=value.

entries.name: Ctrl+Y
entries.description: Paste deleted text
entries.outputBehavior: Pastes the text you last deleted with one of the word or line deletion shortcuts, such as Ctrl+K, Ctrl+U, or Ctrl+W

entries.name: Alt+Y (after Ctrl+Y)
entries.description: Cycle paste history
entries.outputBehavior: After pasting, cycle through previously deleted text. Requires Option as Meta on macOS

entries.name: Alt+B
entries.description: Move cursor back one word
entries.outputBehavior: Word navigation. Requires Option as Meta on macOS

entries.name: Alt+F
entries.description: Move cursor forward one word
entries.outputBehavior: Moves to the end of the current word, or to the end of the next word when the cursor is between words. Requires Option as Meta on macOS

entries.name: Alt+D
entries.description: Delete to end of word
entries.outputBehavior: Deletes to the end of the current word, or to the end of the next word when the cursor is between words. Stores deleted text for pasting.

entries.name: Ctrl+_ or Ctrl+Shift+-
entries.description: Undo last input edit
entries.outputBehavior: Restores the previous input text and cursor position

entries.name: Ctrl+T
entries.description: Toggle syntax highlighting for code blocks
entries.outputBehavior: Only works inside the /theme picker menu. Controls whether code in Claude's responses uses syntax coloring

entries.name: \ + Enter
entries.description: Quick escape
entries.outputBehavior: Works in all terminals

entries.name: Option+Enter
entries.description: Option key
entries.outputBehavior: After enabling Option as Meta on macOS

entries.name: Shift+Enter
entries.description: Shift+Enter
entries.outputBehavior: Native in iTerm2, WezTerm, Ghostty, Kitty, Warp, Windows Terminal 1.25 or later. For other terminals, see Enter multiline prompts

entries.name: Ctrl+J
entries.description: Control sequence
entries.outputBehavior: Works in any terminal without configuration

entries.name: Paste directly
entries.description: Paste mode
entries.outputBehavior: For code blocks, logs

entries.name: / at start
entries.description: Command or skill
entries.outputBehavior: See commands and skills

entries.name: ! at start
entries.description: Shell mode
entries.outputBehavior: Run a command directly, add its output to the session, and have Claude respond to it

entries.description: File path mention
entries.outputBehavior: Trigger file path autocomplete. In sessions with cross-session messaging, when you type at least one letter after the @, Claude Code also suggests your other live sessions on this machine, so you can tell Claude to message the one you pick.

entries.description: Emoji shortcode
entries.outputBehavior: Type a full :name: to insert the emoji, or two or more characters for suggestions. See Emoji shortcodes

entries.name: ? on empty input
entries.description: Toggle the shortcut help panel
entries.outputBehavior: Typing ? when the input already contains text inserts the character

entries.description: Toggle the keyboard shortcut help panel. Requires fullscreen rendering
Jump to the previous or next user prompt, like vim paragraph motion. Requires fullscreen rendering

entries.name: Ctrl+E
entries.description: Toggle show all content. Available in the classic renderer only, not in fullscreen rendering
Write the full conversation to your terminal's native scrollback so Cmd+F, tmux copy mode, and other native tools can search it. Requires fullscreen rendering

entries.name: v
entries.description: Write the conversation to a temporary file and open it in $VISUAL or $EDITOR. Requires fullscreen rendering

entries.name: q, Ctrl+C, Esc
entries.description: Exit transcript view. All three can be rebound via transcript:exit

entries.name: Hold or tap Space
entries.description: Voice dictation
entries.outputBehavior: Requires voice dictation to be enabled. Hold to record, or run /voice tap for tap-to-toggle.

entries.name: model
entries.description: Choose the active model (and reasoning effort, when available).
entries.outputBehavior: Select GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday coding if your workspace has access.

entries.name: presets
entries.description: Save and run prompts or slash commands.
entries.outputBehavior: Recall a command or prompt you use frequently.

entries.name: daybreak
entries.description: Toggle Daybreak when your account and model are eligible.
entries.outputBehavior: Use an approved cyber access program for a chat.

entries.name: ide
entries.description: Include open files, current selection, and other IDE context.
entries.outputBehavior: Pull editor context into the next prompt without re-explaining what's open in your IDE.

entries.name: permissions
entries.description: Set what Codex can do without asking first.
entries.outputBehavior: Relax or tighten approval requirements mid-session, such as switching between Auto and Read Only.

entries.name: keymap
entries.description: Remap TUI keyboard shortcuts.
entries.outputBehavior: Inspect and persist custom shortcut bindings in config.toml.

entries.name: vim
entries.description: Toggle Vim mode for the composer.
entries.outputBehavior: Switch between Vim normal/insert behavior and the default composer editing mode.

entries.name: setup-default-sandbox
entries.description: Set up the elevated agent sandbox (Windows only).
entries.outputBehavior: Replace the degraded Windows sandbox after Codex offers the elevated setup.

entries.name: experimental
entries.description: Toggle experimental features.
entries.outputBehavior: Enable options such as Network proxy or Prevent sleep while running.

entries.name: approve
entries.description: Approve one retry of a recent auto review denial.
entries.outputBehavior: Retry a command or action that the auto reviewer denied.

entries.name: memories
entries.description: Configure memory use and generation.
entries.outputBehavior: Turn memory injection or memory generation on or off without leaving the TUI.

entries.name: skills
entries.description: Browse and use skills.
entries.outputBehavior: Improve task-specific behavior by selecting a relevant local skill.

entries.name: import
entries.description: Import Claude Code or Cursor setup, projects, and chats.
entries.outputBehavior: Migrate supported external-agent artifacts into Codex configuration and local files.

entries.name: hooks
entries.description: View and manage lifecycle hooks.
entries.outputBehavior: Inspect configured hooks, trust new or changed hooks, or disable non-managed hooks before they run.

entries.name: review
entries.description: Ask Codex to review your working tree.
entries.outputBehavior: Run after Codex completes work or when you want a second set of eyes on local changes.

entries.name: rename
entries.description: Rename the current chat.
entries.outputBehavior: Give a saved session a recognizable name without leaving the TUI.

entries.name: new
entries.description: Start a new chat inside the same CLI session.
entries.outputBehavior: Reset the chat context without leaving the CLI when you want a fresh prompt in the same repo.

entries.name: archive
entries.description: Archive the current session.
entries.outputBehavior: Remove the current session from active session lists without deleting its transcript.

entries.name: delete
entries.description: Permanently delete the current session.
entries.outputBehavior: Remove the transcript and descendant sessions when archiving isn't enough.

entries.name: resume
entries.description: Resume a saved chat from your session list.
entries.outputBehavior: Continue work from a previous CLI session without starting over.

entries.name: fork
entries.description: Fork the current chat into a new chat.
entries.outputBehavior: Branch the active session to explore a new approach without losing the current transcript.

entries.name: worktree
entries.description: Start or continue a chat in a managed Git worktree.
entries.outputBehavior: Work in a separate checkout of a local repository.

entries.name: app
entries.description: Continue the current session in the ChatGPT desktop app.
entries.outputBehavior: Move from the TUI to the desktop app on macOS or Windows.

entries.name: init
entries.description: Generate an AGENTS.md scaffold in the current directory.
entries.outputBehavior: Capture persistent instructions for the repository or subdirectory you're working in.

entries.name: compact
entries.description: Summarize the visible chat to free tokens.
entries.outputBehavior: Use after long runs so Codex retains key points without blowing the context window.

entries.name: config
entries.description: Search and change terminal preferences.
entries.outputBehavior: Adjust the theme, notifications, keyboard shortcuts, or text selection.

entries.name: recap
entries.description: Generate a summary of the current conversation.
entries.outputBehavior: Catch up on the chat without compacting its context.

entries.name: plan
entries.description: Switch to plan mode and optionally send a prompt.
entries.outputBehavior: Ask Codex to propose an execution plan before implementation work starts.

entries.name: voice
entries.description: Start or stop a voice conversation when available.
entries.outputBehavior: Speak to Codex in a terminal build that supports voice.

entries.name: goal
entries.description: Set, edit, pause, resume, view, or clear a task goal.
entries.outputBehavior: Give Codex a persistent target to track while a larger task runs.

entries.name: agents
entries.description: Open the agent command center.
entries.outputBehavior: Browse chats and switch between agents on the connected server.

entries.name: side
entries.description: Open a side chat.
entries.outputBehavior: Ask a focused follow-up without disrupting the main chat's transcript.

entries.name: btw
entries.description: Open a side chat.
entries.outputBehavior: Ask a focused follow-up without disrupting the main chat's transcript.

entries.name: copy
entries.description: Copy a response, code block, or quote.
entries.outputBehavior: Use Ctrl+ O  to copy the latest completed response without using the menu.

entries.name: export
entries.description: Export the conversation as Markdown.
entries.outputBehavior: Save a complete transcript to a file or copy it to the clipboard.

entries.name: raw
entries.description: Toggle raw scrollback mode.
entries.outputBehavior: Make terminal selection and copying less formatted while reviewing long output.

entries.name: tui
entries.description: Choose the terminal mode for the next launch.
entries.outputBehavior: Switch between terminal scrollback and a fullscreen transcript.

entries.name: diff
entries.description: Show the Git diff, including files Git isn't tracking yet.
entries.outputBehavior: Review Codex's edits before you commit or run tests.

entries.name: mention
entries.description: Attach a file to the chat.
entries.outputBehavior: Point Codex at specific files or folders you want it to inspect next.

entries.name: status
entries.description: Display session configuration and token usage.
entries.outputBehavior: Confirm the active model, approval policy, writable roots, and remaining context capacity.

entries.name: daemon
entries.description: Open background server controls.
entries.outputBehavior: Inspect the connection and manage a local server owned by Codex.

entries.name: warnings
entries.description: View retained warnings and diagnostics.
entries.outputBehavior: Revisit warnings that appeared during the session.

entries.name: cd
entries.description: Change the session's working directory.
entries.outputBehavior: Continue an idle primary chat in another directory.

entries.name: pwd
entries.description: Show the working directory.
entries.outputBehavior: Check the directory the active session uses.

entries.name: usage
entries.description: View account token usage or use a rate-limit reset.
entries.outputBehavior: Inspect daily, weekly, or cumulative ChatGPT token activity from inside the TUI.

entries.name: debug-config
entries.description: Print config layer and requirements diagnostics.
entries.outputBehavior: Debug precedence and policy requirements, including experimental network constraints.

entries.name: title
entries.description: Configure terminal window or tab title fields interactively.
entries.outputBehavior: Pick and reorder title items such as project, status, thread, branch, model, and task progress.

entries.name: statusline
entries.description: Configure TUI status-line fields interactively.
entries.outputBehavior: Pick and reorder footer items (model/context/limits/git/tokens/session) and persist in config.toml.

entries.name: theme
entries.description: Choose a syntax-highlighting theme.
